dedupe_keys.name: fire wcisg integrated wildfire and urban growth model for informal settlements

description: Fire-WCISG couples a wildfire model with an urban growth model of an informal settlement to test how fire management strategies affect the number and type of residents who stay and the fire-dependent fynbos vegetation next to the settlement. Residents decide with a hybrid of protection motivation theory, place attachment and Turner's typology of informal residents as described by Christ and colleagues in Habitat International in 2023, while the vegetation follows published fynbos ecology. Fire is simulated with the model by Rohan Fisher and colleagues, and the two models talk to each other through the NetLogo LevelSpace extension. It was published by Sven Christ on CoMSES in July 2026. Coverage: an informal settlement at the wildland edge in a South African fynbos setting. Access: free NetLogo code on CoMSES. Licence: GPL-3.0. Caveats: a research model; not peer reviewed on CoMSES. Simulation uses are wildfire exposure and adaptation scenarios for informal housing at the wildland-urban interface. Related records: the CAUS urban systems model and the NIER retrofit model.
